notes.title: Decarnation - now available in Japanese
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We are very pleased to share with you all that Decarnation now features Japanese localisation! 
With this addition, players from Japan can now fully immerse themselves in the chilling world of Decarnation, enjoying the game in their native language.

- Atelier QDB / Shiro Unlimited

notes.title: Update 2: Patchnotes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40924637/898524b735460f69b22ace7db473bd62204aa927.png[/img]

[quote]Hello Explorers of dreams,

Thank you all your warm reviews and great feedback. It's been fantastic seeing such a positive reaction to the game, and the team are thrilled to see all of the discussion surrounding the game!

But first two bits of (good) news:
-We're adding a new Decarnation demo very soon. Tell your friends, if they haven't played Decarnation yet! 
-Many of you shared your enjoyment of our soundtrack. Good news! It's coming on Spotify, Apple Music, and more other sites, June 23rd!
[/quote]

With that out of the way, let's jump into the patchnotes:

[u][h1]DECARNATION PATCH 2:[/h1][/u]

[h2]ACHIEVEMENTS (REMINDER)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievements that didn't unlock properly (it's retroactive: if you completed their conditions already, update the game, launch a scene and you should see achievements unlocking)
[/list]
[h2]ACCESSIBILITY[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tweaked some sprites and UIs colors and constrast to help colorblind people on some puzzles
[*] Added doormats on some doors to make them easily noticeable
[/list]
[h2]QUALITY[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added images in the scene selection to better visualize scenes
[*] Improved the rythm mini-games (latency and difficulty)
[*] Improved rythm mini-game UI for long inputs
[*] Added pigeons and rats in some areas of the game
[*] Added Big Boo (hidden in Gloria's building), Lino and Gabin characters (nearby the subway).
[*] Polished camera movement and character position of some scenes
[*] Improved some dialogue timings
[*] Slightly modified a few dialogues
[*] Added a few more SFX
[/list]
[h2]BALANCING[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tweaked gym mini-game (longer and clearer)
[*] Tweaked Onichase mini-game (more intense and slightly shorter)
[/list]
[h2]BUGS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some animation issues
[*] Fixed UI text positions on some languages.
[*] Fixed spelling issues in different languages
[*] Fixed collisions issues
[*] Fixed some visual bugs
[*] Fixed some out of bounds issues
[*] Fixed some settings issues
[*] Fixed a dance mini-game soft lock when changing audio settings
[*] Fixed some camera issues
[*] Fixed some sound issues
[/list]

[quote]Thanks again for your feedback, and if you planned to play another round of Decarnation, now's the time![/quote]

notes.title: Update 1: Patchnotes
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone,

We would like to warmly [b]thank you all for your invaluable feedback, reports, and reviews[/b]. The entire Decarnation team is fully committed to addressing the issues and feedback that have been raised across various platforms, especially in the Steam community hub.

We're, releasing today[b] the first post-launch update for Decarnation[/b] (another one is already in the making). Here's the patchnote for PC:

[h2]Achievements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievements that didn't unlock properly (it's retroactive: if you completed their conditions already, update the game, launch a scene and you should see achievements unlocking)[/list]

[h2]Quality Improvements[/h2][list]
[*] Improved main menu's visuals
[*] Improved staging on some scenes of act 6
[*] Improved some camera movements
[*] Added missing lights and shades on some environments[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the difficulty of the "heartbeat" minigame.
[*] Removed a step in the "direction & orientation" minigame (in nightmarish Paris), and a mistake doesn't reset the whole sequence anymore.[/list]

[h2]Bugs/Freezes/Issues[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed spelling issues in different languages
[*] Fixed collisions, depths, and out of bounds issues
[*] Fixed issues with text lines appearing in the wrong place
[*] Fixed issues where in specific conditions Gloria could freeze and would require to restart the scene
[*] Fixed issues with sounds not playing correctly or not stopping when pausing the game
[*] Fixed issues where the sound of characters talking could carry on from scene to scene and not go away until another dialogue started
[*] Fixed an issue where the instruction UI could duplicate after switching from keyboard to controller and from controller to keyboard
[*] Fixed some audio/visuals lag issues with the dance minigame (more to come in the next patch!)[/list]

Thank you all again for your feedback and your enthusiast support !

[i]Note to our dear Switch players, we will release Patch 1 & 2 together once both are ready. We're sorry for the inconvinience. Thanks![/i]
